readings.summary: Implement the core attributed partial-formatter generation feature, with contractless public-member serialization fallback and honoring any MessagePack attributes already present on T, but without adding the merely suggested surrogate-type API.
readings.code_difference: The generator implements IMessagePackFormatter<T> in the annotated bodyless partial class and adjusts member/key discovery for external T, while GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute needs no SurrogateType property or surrogate-based key mapping.

readings.summary: Implement the core formatter generation feature together with the suggested optional SurrogateType API so callers can supply MessagePack-attributed surrogate types whose property names determine keys and settings for Project A types.
readings.code_difference: In addition to generating the partial formatter, the public attribute exposes SurrogateType and the generator and relevant analyzers resolve and validate a surrogate, map its members to T by property name, and use its attributes instead of relying solely on T's contractless shape or own attributes.

data.quote: AArnott suggested a surrogate-type design: `[GeneratedMessagePackFormatter(SurrogateType = typeof(ProjectASurrogate))]`, keys mapped by property name; reporter: "Looks good." No design was settled in the thread.
